sources.title: Holding hands with Plateosaurus
sources.supports: Actual Tuebingen mounted adult skeleton photograph, named GPIT/RE/7288 on right; primary researcher describes hands and restricted pronation. Study hand and lower arm borrow nearly equal-size GPIT Skelett 2, a composite of two individuals; the living reconstruction is not an untouched single-specimen copy.
sources.rights: Heinrich Mallison photograph; no general reuse grant verified. Private reference only, no embedded image.

sources.title: The Digital Plateosaurus I
sources.supports: Primary skeletal biomechanics supports stable biped with subhorizontal back. Fig1 caption distinguishes actual mount and virtual composite including SMNS13200 skull and GPIT2 parts.
sources.rights: Copyright Palaeontological Association2010; cited only, no figure embedded.

sources.title: Baby dinosaurs were little adults
sources.supports: Real Fabian juvenile fossil mount shown separately; adult length range and modern P.trossingensis name. Juvenile hands/neck can differ, not an adult proportion template.
sources.rights: Sauriermuseum Frick photograph, restricted press context; private study only, not embedded.
